title: Concept: Concourse console is reachable without authentication
description: Concourse renders each pipeline as a graph of resources and jobs, and its resource definitions name registries, buckets and deployment targets. A public UI therefore documents the delivery pipeline and the credentials it references.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller maps the deployment pipeline and the internal systems it touches, and with an unauthenticated fly CLI can trigger jobs.
